map.刀痕间距是刀刃每转一圈、皮张前进的距离：间距越小，单位长度内切削次数越多，表面越: Blade-mark pitch is the distance the hide advances per blade revolution: the smaller the pitch, the more cuts per unit length and the finer the surface; too large a pitch causes rippling and thickness variation. This page derives the pitch and theoretical removal from kinematics and grades the parameters against empirical bands — the score reflects how coarse the combination is, not measured thickness uniformity; use a thickness gauge at several points for formal acceptance. If removal is large, split it into two passes to limit force and thickness variation.

map.刀痕间距 = 1000 × 进给速度 ÷ 转速（mm/rev）；切除量 = 来料: Pitch = 1000 × feed ÷ speed (mm/rev); removal = incoming − target thickness; the score is banded by pitch (≤0.5, ≤1, ≤2, ≤4, >4 → 100, 85, 70, 50, 30). For example feed 8 m/min at 4000 rpm → pitch 2.00 mm/rev → 70 (fair); raising the speed to 8000 rpm → 1.00 mm/rev → 85 (good).
map.来料 2.0 mm、目标 1.2 mm、转速 4000 rpm、进给 8 m/m: Incoming 2.0 mm, target 1.2 mm, 4000 rpm, feed 8 m/min: removal 0.80 mm, pitch 1000×8÷4000 = 2.00 mm/rev, score 70 (fair); at 1200 rpm the same feed gives 6.67 mm/rev and a score of 30 (reject), so raise the speed or lower the feed. The score reflects parameter coarseness only; actual thickness still needs spot checks.
map.评分是实测均匀度吗？: Is the score a measured uniformity value?
map.不是。评分只按刀痕间距分档，反映参数组合的粗细程度；实际厚度精度还受刀片锋利度、: No. The score is banded by blade-mark pitch and reflects how coarse the parameter combination is; actual thickness precision also depends on blade sharpness, hide moisture and tension, so use a thickness gauge at several points.
map.进给太快为什么不好？: Why is too fast a feed bad?
map.进给越快、转速不变时刀痕间距越大，单位长度内切削次数减少，易出现波纹与厚度不均；: The faster the feed at a fixed speed, the larger the blade-mark pitch and the fewer cuts per unit length, easily causing ripples and uneven thickness; lower the feed or raise the speed to reduce the pitch and improve surface flatness.
map.为什么要求来料厚度大于目标厚度？: Why must incoming thickness exceed the target?
map.削匀只去除余量，来料必须留有余量才能达到目标厚度；相等或更薄时没有可切除材料，参: Skiving only removes excess; the incoming hide must have stock to reach the target. If it is equal or thinner there is nothing to remove, and no parameter setting can help.
